entries.title: Hollow Knight

primary.version: Current PC build with post-2026 update features
primary.why: Hollow Knight released on Windows first, then macOS, Linux, Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and in 2026 upgraded PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 editions. Windows remains the best archive route because Team Cherry's 2026 refresh added current-platform and PC-oriented improvements such as higher resolutions, frame-rate options, and ultrawide support.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build through Steam or GOG. Verify the post-2026 update branch/features before capture.

entries.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong

primary.why: Silksong released as a full standalone sequel on Linux, macOS, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the best archive route because it has a well-supported PC version and provides the strongest capture/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build through Steam, GOG, or Humble. Revisit free expansion content after it has shipped and can be verified.
